changes.text: Scanner injects $GITHUB_TOKEN into https://github.com/... clone/fetch URLs so private repos can be scanned without per-repo credentials
Deploy workflow writes GITHUB_TOKEN into .env from the GH_PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN repo secret so private-repo access survives reboots and redeploys
Caddyfile: serve HTTP on :80 when DOMAIN is unset so IP/LAN access works; HSTS now only sent over HTTPS
Initial scaffold — register repos, scan every commit, browse timeline + per-commit architecture snapshots
Python AST analyzer with LOC, fan-in/out, instability, LCOM4 per module
Generic LOC fallback for non-Python files (TODO: deeper analysis via tree-sitter)
Hot-spots view — modules with worst-trending metrics over a window
Configurable commit filter (all / since / last_n / range / sha_list); default scans every commit
